title: DELETE /api/v1/team/invites/{id}
description: Owner only, user token: a live invite stops working (expires_at = now()) and frees its seat. {id} is the invite:<uuid> row id of GET /team or the bare uuid. Refusals: 403 not_owner / user_token_required, 404 invite_invalid (unknown, expired, accepted or another team's).
